svg.title: Molecule of the day: Nifedipine
svg.desc: A rotating 3D structure of Nifedipine while a graph neural network predicts its lipophilicity (logD) as 2.82.
svg.text: MW 346.3 · cLogP 2.18 · TPSA 107.8 · HBD 1 · HBA 7 · RotB 4
3-layer message-passing GNN · 4,200 molecules · held-out RMSE 0.603 (R² 0.731) · descriptors from RDKit
